question: No wa'i. shayi am woodi caɗeele — tabo masu duhu a kan ganye da ƙananan harbe. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: tea mosquito bug (Helopeltis antonii). bug yana huda ganye yana tsotse ruwa. Ko mbaɗata: fesa neem oil. Woto yejjito — datse rassan da suka kamu.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — shayi

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da V-shaped lesions na kabeji m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: black rot (Xanthomonas campestris). Ọ na-agbasa site na kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Ngwọta: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 3.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — kabeji

question: Sannu. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka kuɓewa e ndemri la'ano am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka kuɓewa e la'ano: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. kuɓewa tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — la'ano

question: Sannu. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka sunflower e ndemri sunflower am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka sunflower e sunflower: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. sunflower tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — sunflower

question: Ina kwana. dabino na da matsala — larvae suna rami cikin kututture suna raunana bishiyar. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: palm weevil (Rhynchophorus phoenicis). manyan kwari suna zuwa ga raunuka a kututture. Abin da za ka yi: guji raunata kututture yayin datsewa. Kada ka manta — tarkon pheromone don sa ido.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — dabino

question: E karo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le kiwon shanu masu nono fun oko ifunni mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori kiwon shanu masu nono fun ifunni: nonon shanu sau biyu a rana da safe da yamma. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe kiyaye tsaftar wurin nono. bada abinci mai kyau da ruwa mai yawa.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — ifunni

question: Ina kwana. ayaba na da matsala — larvae suna rami cikin corm suna sa bishiyar faɗi. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus). manyan kwari suna ɓoye a cikin tarkacen gona. Abin da za ka yi: amfani da yankan shuka mai tsabta (tissue culture). Kada ka manta — kama manyan kwari da ɓangaren pseudostem.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — ayaba

question: Mbaaɗa. kasu am woodi caɗeele — rassan da suka mutu da ramuka a haushi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cashew stem girdler. beetle yana datse rassan. Ko mbaɗata: datse rassan da suka kamu. Woto yejjito — tsaftace gonar.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — kasu

question: Se dada ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka sunflower fun oko sunflower mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka sunflower fun sunflower: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. sunflower tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — sunflower

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi noman auduga n'ugbo cotton m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka noman auduga na cotton: shuka a farkon damina. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 90cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. datse rassan da suka mutu don rage cututtuka.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — cotton

question: Ina kwana. Na ga ganye masu rawaya da tsuguno a jikin dankali. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: sweet potato virus disease (SPVD). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar whiteflies da aphids suna yada shi. Magani: amfani da vines marasa cuta. cire tsirrai masu cuta.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — dankali

question: Sannu. Mi yi'i tabo masu launin ruwan kasa a kan ganye e kohi am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: leaf spot (Alternaria amaranthi). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Nyawndam: fesa jan karfe fungicide. rage yawan shayarwa a kan ganye.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — kohi

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri tabo masu duhu a ganye da mutuwar kurangar lori isu mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: yam anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides). O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus yana yaduwa a lokacin damina. Itoju: amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar TDr 95/19177. kar a shuka a cikin ƙasa mai ruwa.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — isu

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. koko m nwere nsogbu — tabo a kan kwasfa da harbuna. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis). mirids suna allurar ruwan guba. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa bifenthrin a daidai adadin. Echefula — sarrafa inuwa yana rage yawan mirid.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — koko

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka ayaba n'ugbo ogidi m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka ayaba na ogidi: shuka suckers lafiya daga tushe mai dogara. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 3m tsakanin tsirrai. shafa mulch don adana danshi.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — ogidi

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ratsi rawaya a kan ganye na oka m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: maize streak virus (MSV). Ọ na-agbasa site na leafhoppers ne ke yada cutar. Ngwọta: cire tsirrai masu cuta da wuri. kwayar cutar ba ta da magani da zarar ta kama tsiron.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — oka

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — nkwu

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri tabo masu duhu a kan 'ya'yan itace da ganye lori gbogiri mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: anthracnose. O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Itoju: fesa fungicide a lokacin flowering. juya amfanin gona.

question: Se dada ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le kula da kofi fun oko kofi mi. Kini imoran re?

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe agbado mi ni ramukan ganye da tsutsa a cikin ganyen. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

answer: fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda). kwari na yin kwai da dare a kan masara — larvae suna ciyarwa a ciki. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesa neem (azadirachtin) a farkon girma. Ma gbagbe — cutar tana yaduwa da sauri ba tare da magani ba — a dauki mataki cikin kwana 3.

answer: powdery mildew. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana hana samar da 'ya'yan itace. Ngwọta: fesa sulfur fungicide. datse don iska mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — kashu

question: E karo. Mo ri tabo masu duhu a kan ganye suna rage photosynthesis lori ogede mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: black sigatoka (Mycosphaerella fijiensis). O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus yana yaduwa da iska. Itoju: fesa fungicide a kai a kai. datse ganye masu cuta.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — ogede

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. sorghum m nwere nsogbu — ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa a cikin tsirrai. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: sorghum shoot fly (Atherigona soccata). kwai suna kwantawa a kan ƙananan ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin ƙudaje. Echefula — amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar SAMSORG 40.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — sorghum

question: Mbaaɗa. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka gyada e ndemri biriiji am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka gyada e biriiji: shuka iri a zurfin 5cm. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 15cm tsakanin tsirrai. gyada tana buƙatar ƙasa mai sauƙi (sandy loam).
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — biriiji

question: Barka dai. Na ga ratsi rawaya a kan ganye a jikin masara. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: maize streak virus (MSV). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar leafhoppers ne ke yada cutar. Magani: cire tsirrai masu cuta da wuri. kwayar cutar ba ta da magani da zarar ta kama tsiron.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — masara

question: E karo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le noman dawa fun oko baba mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori noman dawa fun baba: shuka iri a zurfin 3-5cm. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 20cm tsakanin tsirrai. dawa tana jure fari fiye da masara.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — baba

question: Sannu. Ina so in san yadda zan kula da bishiyar mangwaro a aikin mangwaro don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da kula da bishiyar mangwaro a aikin mangwaro: datse rassan da suka mutu a kowace shekara. Wannan yana taimakawa domin shafa takin organic a kusa da tushe. ruwan shayarwa a lokacin rani.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — mangwaro

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe pakí mi ni ganye masu launin rawaya da dige-dige. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: cassava green mite (Mononychellus tanajoa). mites suna yaduwa a lokacin rani. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesa man neem ko acaricide. Ma gbagbe — cutar mai tsanani tana rage yawan rogo da kashi 60%.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — pakí

question: A salaamun alaikum. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka kankana e ndemri kankana am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka kankana e kankana: shuka iri kai tsaye a cikin gona. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 2m tsakanin layuka, 1m tsakanin tsirrai. kankana tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — kankana

question: E karo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka ayaba fun oko ogede mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka ayaba fun ogede: shuka suckers lafiya daga tushe mai dogara. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 3m tsakanin tsirrai. shafa mulch don adana danshi.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — ogede

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka sunflower n'ugbo sunflower m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka sunflower na sunflower: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. sunflower tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — sunflower

question: Sannu da aiki. barkono na da matsala — 'ya'yan itace suna ruɓewa daga ciki da tsutsa. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: pepper fruit fly (Bactrocera latifrons). ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Abin da za ka yi: girbi a kai a kai kafin kwari su taru. Kada ka manta — rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — barkono

question: Sannu da aiki. Na ga tabo masu ruwa a kan ganye a jikin auduga. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: bacterial blight (Xanthomonas campestris pv. malvacearum). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Magani: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — auduga

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m tabo masu kusurwa a kan ganye da ruwan kasa na agwa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: angular leaf spot. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Ngwọta: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — agwa

question: E karo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka alaiho fun oko tete mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka alaiho fun tete: watsa iri a kan gona da aka shirya. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe shayarwa a kai a kai. girbi bayan makonni 4-6.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — tete

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kula da bishiyar mangwaro n'ugbo mangolo m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — mangolo

question: Ina kwana. Ina so in san yadda zan kiwon shanu masu nono a aikin kiwo don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da kiwon shanu masu nono a aikin kiwo: nonon shanu sau biyu a rana da safe da yamma. Wannan yana taimakawa domin kiyaye tsaftar wurin nono. bada abinci mai kyau da ruwa mai yawa.

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m tabo masu launin toka a kan ƙananan ganye na oka m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: gray leaf spot (Cercospora zeae-maydis). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungal spores a cikin tarkacen gona. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb a kowane mako 2. yana ƙaruwa a lokacin zafi da danshi.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — oka

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri nonuwa masu kumburi da madara mara kyau lori ifunni mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: mastitis. O n tan kaakiri nipa kwayar cuta tana shiga ta nonuwa. Itoju: tsaftace nonuwa kafin da bayan nono. kira likitan dabbobi idan ya yi tsanani.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — ifunni

question: Sannu. dankali am woodi caɗeele — ramuka a cikin tubers da ɗanɗano mai ɗaci. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?

answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka tsarin ciyayi na akpu: fara ciyayi a mako 3 bayan shuka. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na ciyayi na biyu a mako 8. ciyawa masu gasa suna rage girman rogo da kashi 40%.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — akpu

question: Jam na. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka dankali e ndemri dankali am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?

question: Sannu. kankana na da matsala — larvae a cikin 'ya'yan itace suna sa su ruɓe. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kiwon shanu masu nono n'ugbo mmiri ara m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri wipe ogede mi ni ganye masu lankwashewa da aphids a ƙasa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: banana aphid (Pentalonia nigronervosa). aphids suna yada bunchy top virus. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesa sabulun kashe kwari. Ma gbagbe — cire tsirrai masu cutar.

question: Barka dai. Na ga tabo masu kusurwa a kan ganye da ruwan kasa a jikin wake. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: angular leaf spot. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Magani: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri wipe ope mi ni larvae suna rami cikin kututture suna raunana bishiyar. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

question: Barka dai. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka tumatir a aikin tumatir don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka tumatir a aikin tumatir: fara shuka iri a cikin nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin dasawa bayan makonni 3-4. tsaya 60cm tsakanin tsirrai, 90cm tsakanin layuka.

question: Barka dai. Na ga ganye masu rawaya da fari a jikin gero. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: downy mildew (Sclerospora graminicola). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungus yana yaduwa da iska da ruwa. Magani: amfani da iri masu jurewa. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.

question: Barka dai. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka sunflower a aikin sunflower don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m ganye suna bushewa daga gefe na osikapa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

question: Ina kwana. Na ga tabo masu launin toka a kan ƙananan ganye a jikin masara. Wace cuta ce wannan?

answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka sunflower e sunflower: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. sunflower tana buƙatar rana sosai.

question: Ina kwana. Ina so in san yadda zan  girbi da adanawa a aikin wake don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da  girbi da adanawa a aikin wake:  girbi lokacin da kwasfa suka bushe. Wannan yana taimakawa domin adana a cikin jakunkuna masu hana iska (PICS bags). kare daga bruchid weevils a ma'ajiya.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — wake

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. tii m nwere nsogbu — tabo masu duhu a kan ganye da ƙananan harbe. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: tea mosquito bug (Helopeltis antonii). bug yana huda ganye yana tsotse ruwa. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa neem oil. Echefula — datse rassan da suka kamu.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — tii

question: Mbaaɗa. la'ano am woodi caɗeele — kananan ramuka a cikin ganye kamar harsashi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: okra flea beetle (Podagrica uniforma). yawan kamuwa yana lalata ganyen tsirrai. Ko mbaɗata: fesa man neem da ash dusting. Woto yejjito — shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin beetle.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — la'ano

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. unere m nwere nsogbu — ganye masu lankwashewa da aphids a ƙasa. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: banana aphid (Pentalonia nigronervosa). aphids suna yada bunchy top virus. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa sabulun kashe kwari. Echefula — cire tsirrai masu cutar.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — unere

question: Bawo ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka kabeji fun oko kabeji mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka kabeji fun kabeji: fara iri a cikin nursery. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe dasawa bayan makonni 4-5. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — kabeji

question: Sannu da aiki. dabino na da matsala — larvae suna rami cikin kututture suna raunana bishiyar. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: palm weevil (Rhynchophorus phoenicis). manyan kwari suna zuwa ga raunuka a kututture. Abin da za ka yi: guji raunata kututture yayin datsewa. Kada ka manta — tarkon pheromone don sa ido.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — dabino

question: Sannu da aiki. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka kuɓewa a aikin kuɓewa don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka kuɓewa a aikin kuɓewa: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. kuɓewa tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — kuɓewa

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri wipe mangoro mi ni kananan ramuka a kan 'ya'yan itace da tsutsa a ciki. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis). macen ƙuda tana yin kwai a ƙarƙashin fata. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: amfani da tarkon pheromone (methyl eugenol). Ma gbagbe — tattara 'ya'yan da suka faɗi a binne su zurfi.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — mangoro

question: Ina kwana. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka doya a aikin doya don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka doya a aikin doya: amfani da yankan tuber lafiya 500g-800g. Wannan yana taimakawa domin gina tudu 1m nisa. shafa mulch don adana danshi.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — doya

question: Ina kwana. Na ga ganye suna bushewa daga gefe a jikin shinkafa. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: bacterial leaf blight. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Magani: shuka iri mai lafiya da aka tabbatar. ruwan sama da yawa yana kara yaduwa.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — shinkafa

question: Kedu. cotton m nwere nsogbu — larvae suna shiga cikin bolls suna sa su faɗi. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cotton bollworm (Helicoverpa armigera). polyphagous pest — yana kai wa tumatir da masara hari. Ihe ị ga-eme: Bt cotton yana bada juriya. Echefula — fesa ruwan neem a lokacin furanni.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — cotton

question: Assalamu alaikum. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka barkono a aikin barkono don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka barkono a aikin barkono: fara iri a cikin nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin dasawa bayan makonni 6-8. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai, 60cm tsakanin layuka.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — barkono

question: Ek'abo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka albasa fun oko alubosa mi. Kini imoran re?

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe ere mi ni ramuka a cikin kwasfa da tarkace. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: pod borer (Maruca vitrata). moth yana yin kwai a furanni. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesa Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) a lokacin furanni. Ma gbagbe — larva daya tana lalata kwasfa 4-6 a rayuwarta.

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri tabo mai ruwa a kan ganye suna juya launin ruwan kasa lori ere mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: cowpea bacterial blight. O n tan kaakiri nipa ruwan sama yana yada kwayar cutar. Itoju: shafa maganin jan karfe (copper fungicide). amfani da iri mara cuta da aka tabbatar.

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — nkwu

question: Jam na. masar am woodi caɗeele — ganye masu bushewa a tsakiya. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: stem borer (Busseola fusca). moth yana yin kwai a bayan ganye. Ko mbaɗata: fesa carbofuran a lokacin da tsiron ya kai tsayin gwiwa. Woto yejjito — tsutsa tana lalata tushe daga ciki.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — masar

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m tabo masu duhu a kan 'ya'yan itace masu girma na mangolo m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Ngwọta: fesa fungicide kafin girbi. wanke 'ya'yan itace da ruwan zafi bayan girbi.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — mangolo

question: Kedu. oka m nwere nsogbu — ganye masu bushewa a tsakiya. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: stem borer (Busseola fusca). moth yana yin kwai a bayan ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa carbofuran a lokacin da tsiron ya kai tsayin gwiwa. Echefula — tsutsa tana lalata tushe daga ciki.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — oka

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da fari a ƙasa na sunflower m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: downy mildew. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana rayuwa a cikin ƙasa. Ngwọta: amfani da iri masu jurewa. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 3.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — sunflower

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. mangolo m nwere nsogbu — kananan ramuka a kan 'ya'yan itace da tsutsa a ciki. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis). macen ƙuda tana yin kwai a ƙarƙashin fata. Ihe ị ga-eme: amfani da tarkon pheromone (methyl eugenol). Echefula — tattara 'ya'yan da suka faɗi a binne su zurfi.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — mangolo

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da fari na millet m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: downy mildew (Sclerospora graminicola). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da iska da ruwa. Ngwọta: amfani da iri masu jurewa. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — millet

question: E ku ise. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka kabeji fun oko kabeji mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka kabeji fun kabeji: fara iri a cikin nursery. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe dasawa bayan makonni 4-5. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — kabeji

question: Sannu. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka alaiho a aikin alaiho don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka alaiho a aikin alaiho: watsa iri a kan gona da aka shirya. Wannan yana taimakawa domin shayarwa a kai a kai. girbi bayan makonni 4-6.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — alaiho

question: No wa'i. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta  girbi da adanawa e ndemri nyebbe am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow  girbi da adanawa e nyebbe:  girbi lokacin da kwasfa suka bushe. Ɗum wallitata sabo adana a cikin jakunkuna masu hana iska (PICS bags). kare daga bruchid weevils a ma'ajiya.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — nyebbe

question: Nnọọ. sorghum m nwere nsogbu — ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa a cikin tsirrai. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: sorghum shoot fly (Atherigona soccata). kwai suna kwantawa a kan ƙananan ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin ƙudaje. Echefula — amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar SAMSORG 40.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — sorghum

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. tii m nwere nsogbu — tabo masu duhu a kan ganye da ƙananan harbe. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: tea mosquito bug (Helopeltis antonii). bug yana huda ganye yana tsotse ruwa. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa neem oil. Echefula — datse rassan da suka kamu.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — tii

question: Ndewo. koko m nwere nsogbu — tabo a kan kwasfa da harbuna. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis). mirids suna allurar ruwan guba. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa bifenthrin a daidai adadin. Echefula — sarrafa inuwa yana rage yawan mirid.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — koko

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe mangoro mi ni kananan ramuka a kan 'ya'yan itace da tsutsa a ciki. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis). macen ƙuda tana yin kwai a ƙarƙashin fata. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: amfani da tarkon pheromone (methyl eugenol). Ma gbagbe — tattara 'ya'yan da suka faɗi a binne su zurfi.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — mangoro

question: Ina kwana. wake na da matsala — ganye masu lankwashewa da ruwan zuma mai dorowa. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: cowpea aphid (Aphis craccivora). aphids suna taruwa a kan ƙananan ganye. Abin da za ka yi: fesa ruwan neem ko sabulun kashe kwari. Kada ka manta — aphids suna yada cutar mosaic virus.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — wake

question: Jam na. kofi am woodi caɗeele — kananan ramuka a cikin kofi berries da lalacewa a ciki. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: coffee berry borer (Hypothenemus hampei). kwari mafi tsanani ga kofi a duniya. Ko mbaɗata: girbi duk berries da suka nuna da wuri. Woto yejjito — amfani da tarkon broca da ethanol-methanol mix.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — kofi

question: Ina kwana. kankana na da matsala — larvae a cikin 'ya'yan itace suna sa su ruɓe. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: melon fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae). ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Abin da za ka yi: rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda. Kada ka manta — girbi da wuri kafin kwari su taru.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — kankana

question: Bawo ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka dankali fun oko anamo mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka dankali fun anamo: shuka vines lafiya 25-30cm tsayi. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 1m tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. shuka a farkon damina.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — anamo

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri wipe alubosa mi ni ganye masu launin azurfa da lankwashewa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: onion thrips (Thrips tabaci). thrips suna tsotse ruwan ganye. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: fesa insecticidal soap. Ma gbagbe — shuka albasa nesa da gonakin allium.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — alubosa

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. akpu m nwere nsogbu — ganye masu launin rawaya da dige-dige. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cassava green mite (Mononychellus tanajoa). mites suna yaduwa a lokacin rani. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa man neem ko acaricide. Echefula — cutar mai tsanani tana rage yawan rogo da kashi 60%.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — akpu

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m tabo masu launin ruwan kasa a kan ganye na green m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: leaf spot (Alternaria amaranthi). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Ngwọta: fesa jan karfe fungicide. rage yawan shayarwa a kan ganye.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — green

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe iresi mi ni ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: rice stem borer. larvae na moth suna shiga cikin tushe. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: shafa carbofuran granules a lokacin panicle initiation. Ma gbagbe — gonakin da ke kusa da ciyawa suna da yawan kamuwa.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — iresi

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka shayi n'ugbo tii m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka shayi na tii: shuka a kan tudu masu magudanar ruwa. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 1.5m tsakanin tsirrai. datse a kai a kai don ƙarfafa sabon girma.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — tii

question: Jam na. citta am woodi caɗeele — 'ya'yan itace suna ruɓewa daga ciki da tsutsa. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?

answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka wake a aikin wake: shuka iri a zurfin 3-5cm. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 50cm tsakanin layuka, 10cm tsakanin tsirrai. wake yana gyara nitrogen a cikin ƙasa.

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka gyada n'ugbo akidi m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?

question: E karo. Mo ri ganye suna zama kunkuntar kuma suna taruwa a sama lori ogede mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: banana bunchy top virus. O n tan kaakiri nipa aphid-transmitted, babu magani. Itoju: tumɓuke da lalata tsirrai masu cutar. amfani da suckers marasa cuta daga tushe mai dogara.

question: Kedu. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da tsuguno na nduku m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — oka

question: Assalamu alaikum. Na ga tabo purple-launin ruwan kasa a kan ganye a jikin albasa. Wace cuta ce wannan?

source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — albasa

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m nonuwa masu kumburi da madara mara kyau na mmiri ara m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

question: Sannu da aiki. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka shinkafa a aikin shinkafa don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka shinkafa a aikin shinkafa: shuka iri a layuka 20cm nesa. Wannan yana taimakawa domin dafa gona da kyau kafin shuka. shuka a farkon damina.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — shinkafa

question: Mbaaɗa. Mi yi'i tabo masu launin toka a kan ƙananan ganye e masar am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: gray leaf spot (Cercospora zeae-maydis). Ɗum saakitoo e fungal spores a cikin tarkacen gona. Nyawndam: fesa mancozeb a kowane mako 2. yana ƙaruwa a lokacin zafi da danshi.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — masar

question: E ku ise. Mo ri wipe ope mi ni larvae suna rami cikin kututture suna raunana bishiyar. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: palm weevil (Rhynchophorus phoenicis). manyan kwari suna zuwa ga raunuka a kututture. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: guji raunata kututture yayin datsewa. Ma gbagbe — tarkon pheromone don sa ido.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — ope

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka kuɓewa n'ugbo okwuru m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka kuɓewa na okwuru: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. kuɓewa tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — okwuru

question: Nnọọ. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka alaiho n'ugbo green m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka alaiho na green: watsa iri a kan gona da aka shirya. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na shayarwa a kai a kai. girbi bayan makonni 4-6.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — green

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m tabo masu duhu a ganye da ruɓewar 'ya'yan itace na tomato m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: late blight (Phytophthora infestans). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana ƙaruwa a lokacin sanyi da danshi. Ngwọta: fesa mancozeb don rigakafi. kar a shuka tumatir kusa da gonar dankali.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — tomato

question: E ku ise. Mo ri tabo masu duhu a kan 'ya'yan itace masu girma lori mangoro mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides). O n tan kaakiri nipa fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Itoju: fesa fungicide kafin girbi. wanke 'ya'yan itace da ruwan zafi bayan girbi.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — mangoro

question: Bawo ni. Mo ri wipe kasu mi ni rassan da suka mutu da ramuka a haushi. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: cashew stem girdler. beetle yana datse rassan. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: datse rassan da suka kamu. Ma gbagbe — tsaftace gonar.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — kasu

question: Jam na. Mi yi'i tabo masu duhu a kan ganye suna rage photosynthesis e ayaba am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: black sigatoka (Mycosphaerella fijiensis). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa da iska. Nyawndam: fesa fungicide a kai a kai. datse ganye masu cuta.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — ayaba

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. agwa m nwere nsogbu — ganye masu lankwashewa da ruwan zuma mai dorowa. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cowpea aphid (Aphis craccivora). aphids suna taruwa a kan ƙananan ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa ruwan neem ko sabulun kashe kwari. Echefula — aphids suna yada cutar mosaic virus.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — agwa

question: Se dada ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le noman auduga fun oko owu mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori noman auduga fun owu: shuka a farkon damina. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 90cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. datse rassan da suka mutu don rage cututtuka.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — owu

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da fari na millet m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: downy mildew (Sclerospora graminicola). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da iska da ruwa. Ngwọta: amfani da iri masu jurewa. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — millet

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m farin foda a kan furanni da ƙananan 'ya'yan itace na mangolo m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: powdery mildew (Oidium mangiferae). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana son iska mai zafi da danshi. Ngwọta: fesa sulfur-based fungicide a lokacin furanni. datse rassan don iska mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — mangolo

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m tabo masu duhu a kan 'ya'yan itace da ganye na watermelon m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: anthracnose. Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Ngwọta: fesa fungicide a lokacin flowering. juya amfanin gona.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — watermelon

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. mmiri ara m nwere nsogbu — ƙanƙara a jikin shanu suna tsotse jini. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: ticks (Rhipicephalus microplus). ticks suna watsa cututtuka kamar East Coast fever. Ihe ị ga-eme: wanka shanu da acaricide a kowane mako 2. Echefula — kiyaye kiwo da tsafta don rage ticks.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — mmiri ara

question: Kedu. Ahụrụ m tsiron yana bushewa ba zato ba tsammani na tomato m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: bacterial wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum). Ọ na-agbasa site na kwayar cuta a cikin ƙasa. Ngwọta: juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 3-4. shuka iri masu jurewa.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — tomato

question: Sannu. dankali na da matsala — ramuka a cikin tubers da ɗanɗano mai ɗaci. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: sweet potato weevil (Cylas puncticollis). weevil yana kai hari a cikin ƙasa. Abin da za ka yi: yi banking na ƙasa don rufe tubers. Kada ka manta — juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — dankali

question: Barka dai. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka wake a aikin wake don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka wake a aikin wake: shuka iri a zurfin 3-5cm. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 50cm tsakanin layuka, 10cm tsakanin tsirrai. wake yana gyara nitrogen a cikin ƙasa.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — wake

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi kula da bishiyar mangwaro n'ugbo mangolo m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka kula da bishiyar mangwaro na mangolo: datse rassan da suka mutu a kowace shekara. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na shafa takin organic a kusa da tushe. ruwan shayarwa a lokacin rani.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — mangolo

question: Jam na. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka tumatir e ndemri tumate am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka tumatir e tumate: fara shuka iri a cikin nursery. Ɗum wallitata sabo dasawa bayan makonni 3-4. tsaya 60cm tsakanin tsirrai, 90cm tsakanin layuka.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — tumate

source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — auduga

question: Jam na. Mi yi'i ganye masu rawaya da fari e gawri am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?

question: Bawo ni. Mo ri wipe ata mi ni 'ya'yan itace suna ruɓewa daga ciki da tsutsa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?

question: Bawo ni. Mo ri farin foda a kan ganye lori ila mi. Arun wo ni eyi?

question: Ina kwana. shinkafa na da matsala — ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: rice stem borer. larvae na moth suna shiga cikin tushe. Abin da za ka yi: shafa carbofuran granules a lokacin panicle initiation. Kada ka manta — gonakin da ke kusa da ciyawa suna da yawan kamuwa.

question: Jam na. koko am woodi caɗeele — tabo a kan kwasfa da harbuna. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: cocoa mirids (Sahlbergella singularis). mirids suna allurar ruwan guba. Ko mbaɗata: fesa bifenthrin a daidai adadin. Woto yejjito — sarrafa inuwa yana rage yawan mirid.

answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka kanju a aikin kanju: shuka a nisan 10m tsakanin bishiyoyi. Wannan yana taimakawa domin shafa takin organic. datse rassan da suka mutu a kai a kai.

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m tabo masu launin ruwan kasa a ganye na akidi m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: early leaf spot (Cercospora arachidicola). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana rayuwa a cikin tarkacen gona. Ngwọta: fesa fungicide a farkon bayyanar. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — akidi

question: A salaamun alaikum. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta noman auduga e ndemri lawol am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow noman auduga e lawol: shuka a farkon damina. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 90cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. datse rassan da suka mutu don rage cututtuka.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — lawol

question: No wa'i. Mi yi'i tabo masu duhu a kan ganye suna rage photosynthesis e ayaba am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: black sigatoka (Mycosphaerella fijiensis). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa da iska. Nyawndam: fesa fungicide a kai a kai. datse ganye masu cuta.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — ayaba

question: A salaamun alaikum. Mi yi'i ganye masu rawaya da fari e gawri am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: downy mildew (Sclerospora graminicola). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa da iska da ruwa. Nyawndam: amfani da iri masu jurewa. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 2.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — gawri

question: Ndewo. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka ayaba n'ugbo ogidi m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka ayaba na ogidi: shuka suckers lafiya daga tushe mai dogara. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 3m tsakanin tsirrai. shafa mulch don adana danshi.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — ogidi

question: E karo. Mo ri ratsi launin ruwan kasa a cikin rogo lori pakí mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: cassava brown streak disease. O n tan kaakiri nipa whiteflies da yankan masu cuta. Itoju: tumɓuke da ƙona tsirrai masu cutar. cutar tana sa rogo ya zama maras ci — ɗanɗano mai ɗaci.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — pakí

question: A salaamun alaikum. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka shinkafa e ndemri marori am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka shinkafa e marori: shuka iri a layuka 20cm nesa. Ɗum wallitata sabo dafa gona da kyau kafin shuka. shuka a farkon damina.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — marori

question: Ndewo. kashu m nwere nsogbu — rassan da suka mutu da ramuka a haushi. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: cashew stem girdler. beetle yana datse rassan. Ihe ị ga-eme: datse rassan da suka kamu. Echefula — tsaftace gonar.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — kashu

question: Sannu da aiki. Na ga tabo masu duhu da ruwa a kan ganye da 'ya'yan itace a jikin barkono. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: bacterial spot (Xanthomonas campestris). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Magani: fesa jan karfe spray a lokacin transplanting. amfani da iri mara cuta daga tushe mai dogara.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — barkono

question: E ku ise. Mo ri wipe ifunni mi ni ƙanƙara a jikin shanu suna tsotse jini. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: ticks (Rhipicephalus microplus). ticks suna watsa cututtuka kamar East Coast fever. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: wanka shanu da acaricide a kowane mako 2. Ma gbagbe — kiyaye kiwo da tsafta don rage ticks.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — ifunni

question: Nnọọ. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi noman auduga n'ugbo cotton m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka noman auduga na cotton: shuka a farkon damina. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 90cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. datse rassan da suka mutu don rage cututtuka.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — cotton

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m tabo masu duhu da ruwa a kan ganye da 'ya'yan itace na ose m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

question: Ezigbo ụbọchị. Ahụrụ m farin foda a kan ganye na okwuru m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — okwuru

question: A salaamun alaikum. nyebbe am woodi caɗeele — tsirrai masu tsuguno da ganye masu rawaya. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: bean fly (Ophiomyia phaseoli). fly larvae suna rami cikin tushe. Ko mbaɗata: shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin ƙuda. Woto yejjito — shafa mulch a kusa da tsirrai.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — nyebbe

question: Ina kwana. Na ga ganye masu rawaya da V-shaped lesions a jikin kabeji. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: black rot (Xanthomonas campestris). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Magani: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 3.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — kabeji

question: Bawo ni. Mo ri wipe isu mi ni ramuka a cikin tubers suna rage darajar kasuwa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: yam beetle (Heteroligus meles). manyan beetles suna ciyarwa da dare. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: shuka mai zurfi (15cm) yana rage lalacewa. Ma gbagbe — shimfiɗa ganyen neem yana korar beetles.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — isu

question: Nnọọ. Ahụrụ m tabo masu duhu a ganye da mutuwar kurangar na ji m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: yam anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides). Ọ na-agbasa site na fungus yana yaduwa a lokacin damina. Ngwọta: amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar TDr 95/19177. kar a shuka a cikin ƙasa mai ruwa.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — ji

question: Assalamu alaikum. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka kabeji a aikin kabeji don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka kabeji a aikin kabeji: fara iri a cikin nursery. Wannan yana taimakawa domin dasawa bayan makonni 4-5. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — kabeji

question: E ku ise. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka gero fun oko jero mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka gero fun jero: watsa iri ko shuka a layuka. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe gero yana jure fari sosai. shuka a farkon damina don amfanin gona mai kyau.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — jero

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Ahụrụ m ganye masu rawaya da fari a ƙasa na sunflower m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?

answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka doya e dundu: amfani da yankan tuber lafiya 500g-800g. Ɗum wallitata sabo gina tudu 1m nisa. shafa mulch don adana danshi.

question: Bawo ni. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka barkono fun oko ata mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka barkono fun ata: fara iri a cikin nursery. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe dasawa bayan makonni 6-8. tsaya 45cm tsakanin tsirrai, 60cm tsakanin layuka.

question: E karo. Mo ri wipe owu mi ni larvae suna shiga cikin bolls suna sa su faɗi. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: cotton bollworm (Helicoverpa armigera). polyphagous pest — yana kai wa tumatir da masara hari. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: Bt cotton yana bada juriya. Ma gbagbe — fesa ruwan neem a lokacin furanni.

question: E karo. Mo fe mo bi mo se le kiwon shanu masu nono fun oko ifunni mi. Kini imoran re?

source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — ifunni

question: Ina kwana. mangwaro na da matsala — kananan ramuka a kan 'ya'yan itace da tsutsa a ciki. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: mango fruit fly (Bactrocera dorsalis). macen ƙuda tana yin kwai a ƙarƙashin fata. Abin da za ka yi: amfani da tarkon pheromone (methyl eugenol). Kada ka manta — tattara 'ya'yan da suka faɗi a binne su zurfi.

question: Sannu. Na ga tabo masu launin toka a kan ganye masu kama da lu'ulu'u a jikin shinkafa. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: rice blast (Pyricularia oryzae). Tana yaduwa ta hanyar fungal spores suna yaduwa da iska. Magani: shuka iri masu jurewa kamar FARO 44. takin nitrogen mai yawa yana kara cutar.

source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — sorghum

question: A salaamun alaikum. sunflower am woodi caɗeele — larvae a cikin kan sunflower suna ciyar da iri. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?

answer: anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa da ruwan sama. Nyawndam: fesa fungicide kafin girbi. wanke 'ya'yan itace da ruwan zafi bayan girbi.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — mangoro

question: Ina kwana. dawa na da matsala — ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa a cikin tsirrai. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: sorghum shoot fly (Atherigona soccata). kwai suna kwantawa a kan ƙananan ganye. Abin da za ka yi: shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin ƙudaje. Kada ka manta — amfani da iri masu jurewa kamar SAMSORG 40.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — dawa

question: E ku ise. Mo fe mo bi mo se le shuka gyada fun oko epa mi. Kini imoran re?
answer: Eyi ni imoran mi lori shuka gyada fun epa: shuka iri a zurfin 5cm. Eyi yoo se iranlowo nitori pe tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 15cm tsakanin tsirrai. gyada tana buƙatar ƙasa mai sauƙi (sandy loam).
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran ise agbe — epa

question: Barka dai. Na ga ratsi launin ruwan kasa a cikin rogo a jikin rogo. Wace cuta ce wannan?
answer: cassava brown streak disease. Tana yaduwa ta hanyar whiteflies da yankan masu cuta. Magani: tumɓuke da ƙona tsirrai masu cutar. cutar tana sa rogo ya zama maras ci — ɗanɗano mai ɗaci.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan gano cuta — rogo

question: Bawo ni. Mo ri wipe kasu mi ni rassan da suka mutu da ramuka a haushi. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: cashew stem girdler. beetle yana datse rassan. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: datse rassan da suka kamu. Ma gbagbe — tsaftace gonar.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — kasu

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka dankali n'ugbo nduku m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka dankali na nduku: shuka vines lafiya 25-30cm tsayi. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 1m tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. shuka a farkon damina.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — nduku

question: Ek'abo. Mo ri ganye masu rawaya da tsuguno lori anamo mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: sweet potato virus disease (SPVD). O n tan kaakiri nipa whiteflies da aphids suna yada shi. Itoju: amfani da vines marasa cuta. cire tsirrai masu cuta.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — anamo

question: A salaamun alaikum. ayaba am woodi caɗeele — larvae suna rami cikin corm suna sa bishiyar faɗi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus). manyan kwari suna ɓoye a cikin tarkacen gona. Ko mbaɗata: amfani da yankan shuka mai tsabta (tissue culture). Woto yejjito — kama manyan kwari da ɓangaren pseudostem.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — ayaba

question: A salaamun alaikum. albasare am woodi caɗeele — ganye masu launin azurfa da lankwashewa. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: onion thrips (Thrips tabaci). thrips suna tsotse ruwan ganye. Ko mbaɗata: fesa insecticidal soap. Woto yejjito — shuka albasa nesa da gonakin allium.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — albasare

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka gero n'ugbo millet m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka gero na millet: watsa iri ko shuka a layuka. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na gero yana jure fari sosai. shuka a farkon damina don amfanin gona mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — millet

question: Jam na. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta kiwon shanu masu nono e ndemri kossam am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow kiwon shanu masu nono e kossam: nonon shanu sau biyu a rana da safe da yamma. Ɗum wallitata sabo kiyaye tsaftar wurin nono. bada abinci mai kyau da ruwa mai yawa.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — kossam

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri wipe iresi mi ni ganye na tsakiya suna bushewa. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: rice stem borer. larvae na moth suna shiga cikin tushe. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: shafa carbofuran granules a lokacin panicle initiation. Ma gbagbe — gonakin da ke kusa da ciyawa suna da yawan kamuwa.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — iresi

question: Ndewo. Ahụrụ m tabo mai ruwa a kan ganye suna juya launin ruwan kasa na agwa m. Kedu ọrịa nke a bụ?
answer: cowpea bacterial blight. Ọ na-agbasa site na ruwan sama yana yada kwayar cutar. Ngwọta: shafa maganin jan karfe (copper fungicide). amfani da iri mara cuta da aka tabbatar.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — agwa

question: Sannu da aiki. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka sunflower a aikin sunflower don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka sunflower a aikin sunflower: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 75cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. sunflower tana buƙatar rana sosai.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — sunflower

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi noman koko n'ugbo koko m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka noman koko na koko: shuka bishiyoyin inuwa kamar plantain. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaftace gonar a kai a kai. fesa jan karfe fungicide don rigakafin black pod.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — koko

question: No wa'i. Miɗo yiɗi anndude no mi waɗirta shuka ayaba e ndemri ayaba am. Ɗume wasiyiiji maa?
answer: Wasiyanke am dow shuka ayaba e ayaba: shuka suckers lafiya daga tushe mai dogara. Ɗum wallitata sabo tsaya 3m tsakanin tsirrai. shafa mulch don adana danshi.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya demal — ayaba

question: Sannu. citta am woodi caɗeele — 'ya'yan itace suna ruɓewa daga ciki da tsutsa. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: pepper fruit fly (Bactrocera latifrons). ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Ko mbaɗata: girbi a kai a kai kafin kwari su taru. Woto yejjito — rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — citta

question: Sannu. Mi yi'i kumburi a kan ganye suna juya fari e shayi am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: blister blight (Exobasidium vexans). Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa a lokacin hazo. Nyawndam: fesa jan karfe fungicide. datse don iska mai kyau.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — shayi

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri wipe gbogiri mi ni larvae a cikin 'ya'yan itace suna sa su ruɓe. Iru kokoro wo ni eyi ati kini mo le se?
answer: melon fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae). ƙuda tana huda 'ya'yan itace don yin kwai. Ohun ti o ye ki o se: rufe 'ya'yan itace da takarda. Ma gbagbe — girbi da wuri kafin kwari su taru.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran kokoro — gbogiri

question: Ndewo. kabeji m nwere nsogbu — kananan ramuka a cikin ganye da larvae kore. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: diamondback moth (Plutella xylostella). moth yana yin kwai a ƙarƙashin ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis). Echefula — juya amfanin gona don karya zagayen rayuwa.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — kabeji

answer: banana bunchy top virus. Ọ na-agbasa site na aphid-transmitted, babu magani. Ngwọta: tumɓuke da lalata tsirrai masu cutar. amfani da suckers marasa cuta daga tushe mai dogara.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrịa — unere

question: Sannu da aiki. auduga na da matsala — larvae suna shiga cikin bolls suna sa su faɗi. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: cotton bollworm (Helicoverpa armigera). polyphagous pest — yana kai wa tumatir da masara hari. Abin da za ka yi: Bt cotton yana bada juriya. Kada ka manta — fesa ruwan neem a lokacin furanni.

question: No wa'i. Mi yi'i nonuwa masu kumburi da madara mara kyau e kossam am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: mastitis. Ɗum saakitoo e kwayar cuta tana shiga ta nonuwa. Nyawndam: tsaftace nonuwa kafin da bayan nono. kira likitan dabbobi idan ya yi tsanani.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — kossam

question: A salaamun alaikum. Mi yi'i hatsi masu canza launi da fungal growth e mbayeeri am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: grain mold. Ɗum saakitoo e yawan danshi a lokacin cika hatsi. Nyawndam: girbi a lokacin physiological maturity. busar da hatsi zuwa danshi 12% nan take.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — mbayeeri

question: Mbaaɗa. ayaba am woodi caɗeele — larvae suna rami cikin corm suna sa bishiyar faɗi. Ɗume ñoɓɓere woni ndee, ɗume mbaɗata?
answer: banana weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus). manyan kwari suna ɓoye a cikin tarkacen gona. Ko mbaɗata: amfani da yankan shuka mai tsabta (tissue culture). Woto yejjito — kama manyan kwari da ɓangaren pseudostem.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya ñoɓɓe — ayaba

question: Se dada ni. Mo ri ganye masu rawaya da V-shaped lesions lori kabeji mi. Arun wo ni eyi?
answer: black rot (Xanthomonas campestris). O n tan kaakiri nipa kwayar cuta tana yaduwa da ruwa. Itoju: amfani da iri mara cuta. juya amfanin gona na tsawon shekaru 3.
source: IAR&T, OAU Ile-Ife, imoran arun — kabeji

question: Kedu. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka kuɓewa n'ugbo okwuru m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka kuɓewa na okwuru: shuka iri a zurfin 2-3cm. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na tsaya 60cm tsakanin layuka, 30cm tsakanin tsirrai. kuɓewa tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — okwuru

question: Sannu. Ina so in san yadda zan shuka kankana a aikin kankana don in samu riba mai kyau. Me za ku ce?
answer: Ga shawarata game da shuka kankana a aikin kankana: shuka iri kai tsaye a cikin gona. Wannan yana taimakawa domin tsaya 2m tsakanin layuka, 1m tsakanin tsirrai. kankana tana son rana da ƙasa mai kyau.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan aikin gona — kankana

question: Ụtụtụ ọma. Achọrọ m ịmata otu m ga-esi shuka gero n'ugbo millet m. Gịnị ka ị ga-adụ m ọdụ?
answer: Nke a bụ ndụmọdụ m maka shuka gero na millet: watsa iri ko shuka a layuka. Nke a na-enyere aka n'ihi na gero yana jure fari sosai. shuka a farkon damina don amfanin gona mai kyau.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ọrụ ugbo — millet

question: Sannu da aiki. rogo na da matsala — ganye masu kama da kube-kube. Wane irin kwaro ne wannan kuma me zan yi?
answer: cassava mealybug (Phenacoccus manihoti). mealybug yana tsotse ruwan ganye. Abin da za ka yi: saki wasp Apoanagyrus lopezi don sarrafawa. Kada ka manta — yana rage girman rogo sosai.
source: NAERLS, ABU Zaria, shawara kan kwari — rogo

question: Jam na. Mi yi'i farin gashi a kan ganye e albasare am. Ɗume rafi woni ɗo'o?
answer: onion downy mildew. Ɗum saakitoo e fungus yana yaduwa a lokacin danshi. Nyawndam: rage yawan shayarwa. shuka iri masu jurewa.
source: ILRI, IAR Samaru, wasiya rafi — albasare

question: Kedu. yorobo m nwere nsogbu — ganye masu launin azurfa da lankwashewa. Kedu ụdị ahụhụ nke a bụ, gịnị ka m ga-eme?
answer: onion thrips (Thrips tabaci). thrips suna tsotse ruwan ganye. Ihe ị ga-eme: fesa insecticidal soap. Echefula — shuka albasa nesa da gonakin allium.
source: NRCRI, Umudike, ndụmọdụ ahụhụ — yorobo
